meta_description: FORN is a one-man army systems and development studio based in Copenhagen, Denmark, focused on platforms, architecture, machine learning and web applications.
bento_one_paragraph: There are (luckily) more options than Cloud or Chaos. I design and develop fundamentally digitally sovereign infrastructure that takes care of itself.
bento_two_paragraph: General models see general patterns, and waste enormous overhead on abilities that are never used. I work in the intersection of data, behavior and prediction, to help future teams solve old world problems with new world tools.
bento_three_paragraph: Web applications that do their job without making a fuss. From internal tooling to full platforms, with all the hard parts made invisible.
bento_four_paragraph: I build systems that shouldn't need me, and leverage experience from development, operations and business alike to create cohesion across professional boundaries.
